The source report did not retain the remaining nodeids or per-case mapping
historical_context.retained_detail: The report retained grouped causes, not the original 38 nodeids. Gate 1 independently reconstructed the exact set from the referenced commit.
historical_context.current_reproduction: 23 CSP failures / 811 passed / 1 skipped on the Gate 1 starting tree plus in-flight F4/F5 wiring.
historical_context.decision: The original report's exact 38 failures and 2 setup errors were independently reproduced from f661f5e8 and are recorded below. Current-tree follow-on failures are tracked separately in observed_failures.

historical_csp_baseline.command: From an isolated git-archive snapshot: cd services/csp && PYTHONUTF8=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m pytest -q
historical_csp_baseline.evidence: Independent Windows/Python 3.11 rerun reproduced 38 failed, 681 passed, 1 skipped, 2 errors in 195.70 seconds.

outcome_groups.cause: The historical runner did not supply the credential-encryption SECRET_KEY, so encryption-dependent cases stopped at the environment contract before their assertions.
outcome_groups.resolution: The required CSP job supplies an explicit CI-only SECRET_KEY; no production fallback or committed secret was introduced.

outcome_groups.cause: SQLite returned timezone-naive UTC datetimes while the credential service compared them with timezone-aware UTC values.
outcome_groups.resolution: Legacy SQLite values are normalized to aware UTC at the comparison boundary; PostgreSQL production semantics are unchanged.

outcome_groups.cause: Registration fixtures no longer satisfied the required request schema and current approval-state contract.
outcome_groups.resolution: Fixtures now include base_model_id, the request envelope, pending_connection_test state, and explicit dev endpoint posture.

outcome_groups.cause: Tests expected hidden 404 routes even though the implemented security policy deliberately keeps them admin-gated and returns 401 anonymously.
outcome_groups.resolution: Tests pin the actual admin-gated contract and verify anonymous callers cannot read OpenAPI or Swagger content.

outcome_groups.cause: The old fixed CMS fixture signed TBS instead of the issued nonce, so the anti-replay check correctly rejected it and dependent flows cascaded.
outcome_groups.resolution: Gate 0 replaced real-person/fixed CMS material with an ephemeral synthetic CA/card that signs each actual nonce while keeping nonce binding enabled.

outcome_groups.cause: The fake asyncpg connection lacked the transaction and execute methods added by the formal SET LOCAL RLS scope contract.
outcome_groups.resolution: The stub now implements transaction, execute, and fetch and asserts the same scoped access sequence as production.

outcome_groups.cause: Earlier tests reloaded app.config and left multiple incompatible settings singleton identities in the process, causing an order-dependent expired-token assertion.
outcome_groups.resolution: Obsolete autouse reload fixtures were removed; focused order-reproduction tests and the required full suite now share one settings identity.

outcome_groups.cause: Windows configparser decoded alembic.ini as CP950 and failed on UTF-8 content.
outcome_groups.resolution: CI runs on UTF-8 Linux, and local validation sets Python UTF-8 explicitly so the documented Alembic command is deterministic.

outcome_groups.cause: Fixtures used removed Agent fields, omitted required API-key prefix/suffix values, and asserted a bulk SET NULL through a stale ORM identity map.
outcome_groups.resolution: Fixtures match current models and expire the ORM identity map before checking the database-side SET NULL result.

outcome_groups.cause: The same config reload pollution left SECRET_KEY empty when later TestClient lifespan setup executed, producing two setup errors rather than test assertions.
outcome_groups.resolution: The reload fixtures were removed and the required job owns a deterministic explicit test secret for the entire process.

observed_failures.resolution: Replaced a hard-coded POSIX string prefix with a Path parent-containment assertion.
Aligned the heading-parent assertion with the current tree contract, made UTF-8 and file scanning platform-neutral, and replaced the removed implicit event-loop API.
Normalize legacy SQLite timezone-naive stored UTC values before Python comparisons; production PostgreSQL semantics remain unchanged.
Updated fixtures for required base_model_id, the seven-state approval value, the request envelope, and explicit dev endpoint posture.
Pinned the current admin-gated contract: anonymous requests receive 401 and never receive the schema or Swagger UI.
Brought the asyncpg stub up to the production transaction and SET LOCAL RLS contract.
Removed obsolete autouse fixtures that reloaded app.config and split the process into inconsistent settings singleton identities.
The required job executes the documented command from services/csp with UTF-8 enabled, so alembic.ini is resolved and decoded correctly.
Removed deleted Agent fields, supplied required API-key fields, and expired the ORM identity map before asserting the bulk SET NULL result.
